_comment: The den's wallpapers and floors. Run with:
Walls are whole-room images (window, shelves and lamp included); floors are cut to
the floor outline and drawn on top of the wall, so any wall goes with any floor.
Everything must be painted to the template below. The shelves are the strict part:
den.gd lands finds on them at fixed heights (BAKED_SHELVES), so a wall whose shelves
sit elsewhere would leave finds floating or sunk. Check build/room_sheets/
'skip' keeps an entry listed, with the reason, without importing it.
Template measured 2026-11-21 off wide-background.png and the floors drawn on black.

template._shelves_note: x, top y, width, in source pixels: den.gd's BAKED_SHELVES doubled.
